title: Diagonal transition map identity from cocycle
statement: Given a ringed space X, opens U indexed by I, local sheaves Fi, overlap isomorphisms φij, and a cocycle identity on all triple overlaps, each diagonal component (φii).hom at every W ≤ U i equals the identity morphism.

source.place: Sheaves, Section 00AK, Lemma 00AL (first proof) and Lemma 00AM; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00AL and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00AM. Universe-small subcover argument supplied by N3.

proof.text: Set i=j=k in the cocycle, then left-compose by the inverse component of φii and simplify using the inverse-hom identity to obtain φii = id.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_transition_identity
    (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (I : Type w) (U : I → Opens X)
    (Fi : ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.{max u v} ((moduleRings X).over (U i)))
    (φij : ∀ i j : I, (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U i)).obj (Fi i) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
      (homOfLE inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U j)).obj (Fi j))
    (hcoc : ∀ (i j k : I) (W : Opens X) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j)
      (hk : W ≤ U k), (φij i k).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk
      (homOfLE (le_inf hi hk)))) = (φij i j).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk
      (homOfLE (le_inf hi hj)))) ≫ (φij j k).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk
      (homOfLE (le_inf hj hk))))) :
    ∀ (i : I) (W : Opens X) (hi : W ≤ U i),
      (φij i i).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hi hi)))) = 𝟙 _
